failure_groups.detail: Five tests construct their accepted document through CreateDeferredCallsFallback, which embeds one synthetic BoundExceeded navigation receipt. One theory has two cases. The fake executions either perform no navigate_code call or use NoOpNavigationService, whose response ReceiptId is Guid.Empty, so AD-32 correctly rejects the synthetic ID as unobserved.

The barrier command omitted the already-approved AnalysisRuntime__JdtLsDistributionArchivePath, so DI failed with jdt_distribution_archive_missing before the composition assertion. The verified archive exists and no installation or host/system change is required.

excluded_causes: DeepSeek endpoint, model, authentication, availability, or response
outbound network, streaming transport, inactivity timeout, or absolute timeout
PostgreSQL availability or ordinary database mutation
privacy: The failed barrier cleared provider credentials and live opt-ins and sent no provider or source-bearing request. PostgreSQL fixtures remained disposable. No ordinary database, host/system, workflow, or Git mutation occurred.
next_step: Replace only the five stale fallback-document constructions with a locally valid receipt-free document helper, retain all wire/timing assertions, and rerun with the approved archive path passed explicitly to the child process.
